newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC 96/97 cement sales, output up.
newsitem.headline: India ACC 96/97 cement sales, output up.

text.p: India's largest cement maker Associated Cement Companies (ACC) said on Thursday its 1996/97 (April-March) cement despatches climbed to 9.05 million tonnes from 8.93 million a year earlier.
ACC said in a statement, cement sales -- including sales of purchased cement and exports -- totalled around 9.8 million tonnes against 9.4 million tonnes in the previous year.
"Cement demand was sluggish in most of the markets, particularly in the second half of the year," ACC said.
The company said its clinker output had risen to 7.46 million tonnes, from 7.08 million in 1995/96.

"Despite major economic slowdown in the second half of 1996/97, and its consequent adverse impact on the steel industry, the company's refractories division has recorded sales turnover of over 1.45 billion rupees," ACC said.
ACC said cement grinding during 1996/97 rose to 9.03 million tonnes, from 8.93 million tonnes in the previous year.
"Capital expenditure during the year under review for cement capacity expansion and captive power generation was in excess of three billion rupees. -- the highest ever in a single year," ACC said.
